name: OTiS synthetic double-integrator benchmark (fold 0)
description: Start/goal pairs for a unit-mass 2D double integrator, drawn with jax.random.fold_in(PRNGKey(0), 10000) - a stream the trainer never uses. optimal_objective is the global optimum of J = |p_T - goal|^2 + lambda * sum(u^2), |u_i| <= 1, from the exact KKT solver (cross-checked against CVXPY/Clarabel and OSQP).
